response.justification: The candidate lacks direct C++ experience in industrial automation or high-performance systems, with most roles centered on web technologies (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang) and no evidence of STL, multi-threading, message brokers, IEC 62443, or industrial protocols — critical for this role.
strengths: Extensive full-stack experience across diverse technologies and domains
Strong open-source contributions and technical communication skills
Proven ability to lead and mentor through workshops and community projects
concerns: Minimal to no recent C++ or STL usage in professional context
No demonstrated experience with industrial cybersecurity standards (IEC 62443) or automation protocols
Lacks exposure to cloud platforms, MQTT, REST in embedded/on-prem industrial systems
